issue.title: Consider upgrading netty version to 4.0.34.Final

repository.name: LittleProxy
repository.description: High performance HTTP proxy originally written by your friends at Lantern and now maintained by a stellar group of volunteer open source programmers.

issue.body:
Upgrading to Netty 4.0.34.Final fixes two netty bugs (that I know of) that impacts littleproxy users - 

1) Fix for https:// requests failing on Android 5.0 - https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/4718 - Fixed in 4.0.34.Final
2) Fix for netty throwing an unexpected TooLongFrameException when a large HTTP header is used (which is still below the configured maxHeaderSize in HttpRequestDecoder/HttpResponseDecoder) - https://github.com/netty/netty/issues/3445 - Fixed in 4.0.26.Final
